_doc: Perks: on-field abilities bought with skill points on the Skills screen (Perks tab). They are a small edge on top of the attributes, never a replacement. Fields: id, name, description (what the player reads), icon (UiIcons), cost (skill points), requires {min: {stat: n} (football or personality stats), perks: [ids owned first], traits: [personality trait ids], stages: [high_school/juco/college/pro/free_agent], min_age: n}, effect. Effect keys (scripts/career/perks.gd): profile {KickProfile fields, e.g. pressure_sensitivity: -0.08}; range_yd / kickoff_yd (yards of field goal / kickoff range); miss_streak (scales miss-streak pressure, -0.4 = 40% less); trust_miss (Coach and Team loss from a miss, -0.2 = 20% less); team_miss (Team loss from a miss); team_pressure (Team standing's game-day pressure effect, 0.5 = 50% stronger); clutch_pressure (game-winning and tying kicks' pressure, -0.25 = 25% less); coach_range_yd (the coach's longest call); return_cut_yd (yards off kickoff returns); onside_window_yd / onside_aim_deg / onside_recover (onside kicks); weather_keep (share of the cold / snow penalty you still take, 0.25); bad_weather {profile fields, in cold or snow}; injury_weeks (weeks off each injury); injury_risk_mult (-0.2 = 20% lower weekly injury chance); aging {stat: change to that attribute's yearly decline, -0.5 = half}.

perks.name: Short Memory
perks.description: A miss is gone by the next snap, and the sideline knows it.

perks.name: Clutch
perks.description: Game on the line? That's when you're at your best.

perks.name: Wind Reader
perks.description: You read the flags and play the wind.

perks.name: Film Junkie
perks.description: You know every stadium's swirl, and your coach knows you did the work.

perks.name: Big Leg
perks.description: A little more on every kick.

perks.name: Cannon
perks.description: The kind of leg scouts drive across the state to see.

perks.name: Smooth Swing
perks.description: Your swing stays smooth when the noise gets loud.

perks.name: Hang Time
perks.description: Kickoffs that go high and deep, so the coverage gets there first.

perks.name: Onside Specialist
perks.description: You can make the ball do strange things off the tee.

perks.name: Cold Weather Kicker
perks.description: Cold nights and snow barely slow you down.

perks.name: Quick Recovery
perks.description: You bounce back from knocks faster.

perks.name: Captain's Calm
perks.description: The locker room follows your lead, good days and bad.

perks.name: Iron Leg
perks.description: Your leg ages slower than everyone else's.
